item.title: Families mark somber anniversary of Chicago nightclub stampede
item.description: On Tuesday, families affected by the E2 nightclub tragedy honored their loved ones who never returned home that night — a somber day in the city's history.It's been 23 years since a stampede killed 21 people who were enjoying a night out. Now, the victims' family members are renewing their calls for a permanent memorial to be erected on Motor Row.
